snippet.title: Short Game Anthology 1.985: Karma Trailer
snippet.description:
Download and play the game now at: https://zetoarrow.itch.io/short-game-anthology-1985-karma

Inspired by South-East Asia urban supernatural stories. Karma is a short freeware first person game that is set in the 1980s Singapore. You are place in an old apartment with an entity haunting the place. As the protagonist, you have to find a way out the apartment by not only exploring the apartment in the real world but also the apartment in the inverse world.

Experience the creepy atmosphere and supernatural happenings in Singapore of the 80s this Halloween.
